title: Mukhyansh: A Headline Generation Dataset for Indic Languages

bias_targets.methodology: Calculating the percentage of duplicate article-headline pairs and overlaps between training, development, and test splits (data leakage), and comparing model performance (ROUGE-L scores) on overlapping versus non-overlapping subsets to demonstrate artificially inflated results.

Evaluating and controlling the category-wise distribution of news articles (e.g., sports, politics, entertainment) across scraped sources and using stratified sampling to ensure no specific news style or topic is overrepresented in the data splits.
